findings.summary: Terminal result is trusted rather than rederived from counts, determinism, cleanup, and evidence.
The parent resolves on the result message before child exit, so serial execution and complete cleanup are not proven.
Invocation lineage is not fully joined to source, manifest, source review, and readiness.
Final tracking uses ambiguous substring checks and accepts contradictory branch state.
The aggregate terminal lacks the privacy-safe per-cell projection needed for independent charge, realism, and cross-pass root adjudication.
The required focused suite can exceed the default five-second test timeout.
